story.title: Activewear that fits, and looks good doing it
paragraphs: QVFITS, by Quivogue, is a Kampala label of activewear, swim and lounge wear for women, sold from our showroom at THE CUBE in Kisementi and delivered across Uganda. The name joins quality and vogue: well made, and worn with style.
Every piece is worn and tested before it joins the range, and carries an honest fit note, so you can choose the right size the first time.

items.title: Small drops
items.text: We make limited quantities of each colourway, so the range stays tight and the quality consistent.

items.title: Honest about fit
items.text: Every piece carries a real fit note, such as runs small, cut relaxed or true to size, so you can order with confidence.

items.title: Styled in person
items.text: Tell us what you train in and we will have pieces ready. Come and try them in the showroom before you buy.

items.title: Delivered across Uganda
items.text: Kampala and upcountry, or collect from the showroom. Free delivery over {freeShipping}.

sizeGuide.title: Size guide
sizeGuide.lede: These are body measurements, not garment measurements. Measure yourself over your underwear, keep the tape snug but not tight, and breathe normally.

measures.name: Bust
measures.text: around the fullest part, tape level at the back.

measures.name: Waist
measures.text: the narrowest point, usually just above the belly button.

measures.name: Hips
measures.text: the fullest part, around 20 cm below your waist.

contact.title: Come see us, or just ask
contact.lede: The fastest answer is a WhatsApp. For anything about fit, fabric or what is in stock, Vee in the corner knows every piece.

form.title: Send a message
form.text: Fill this in and it opens a ready-to-send message. You pick where it goes. We also keep a copy, so the team sees it either way.

vee.title: Ask Vee
